name: cloud.activepieces.com
description: Activepieces is an open-source automation platform that lets you connect apps and automate workflows. The MCP server exposes 44 tools across 7 categories, allowing AI assistants to create, modify, and manage automation flows programmatically. Users can list flows and available integrations, create new automations, configure triggers and steps, manage tables and records, add conditional branches, publish flows, and test runs — all through natural language conversation. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration.

_published_faq.name: How do I add cloud.activepieces.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add cloud.activepieces.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloud.activepieces.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the cloud.activepieces.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: cloud.activepieces.com lists 44 MCP tools, including ap_add_branch, ap_add_step, ap_build_flow, ap_change_flow_status, ap_create_flow, ap_create_table, ap_delete_branch, ap_delete_flow, ap_delete_records, ap_delete_step, ap_delete_table, and ap_duplicate_flow.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to cloud.activepieces.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to cloud.activepieces.com in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
cloud.activepieces.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
cloud.activepieces.com is developed by Activepieces. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
